sectors.title: EU AI uptake by strategic sector

source.name: European Commission JRC
source.description: Share of firms using at least one AI technology. JRC mappings from Eurostat ICT enterprise survey. Strategic groups are not a complete mutually exclusive economy-wide classification. All surveyed sectors is the published benchmark, not an average calculated from these ten groups.

evidenceFlow.title: Published evidence
evidenceFlow.detail: Read https://joint-research-centre.ec.europa.eu/jrc-news-and-updates/ai-adoption-more-doubles-almost-every-eu-strategic-sector-2026-10-14_en (release 2026-10-14); transcribe the rounded published values. Fixed snapshot, no automatic refresh.

methods.code: Transcribe 2021 and 2025 chart endpoints. Change (pp) = 2025 (%) minus 2021 (%). Do not sum sectors or join them to employment rates.

source.name: ONS Labour market overview
source.description: Seasonally adjusted employment rate, ages 16–64. March–May baseline derived from rounded latest rate minus published quarterly change. LFS uncertainty and collection/imputation issues: interpret with PAYE and other evidence.

evidenceFlow.title: Published evidence
evidenceFlow.detail: Read https://www.ons.gov.uk/employmentandlabourmarket/peopleinwork/employmentandemployeetypes/bulletins/uklabourmarket/october2026 (release 2026-10-20); transcribe the rounded published values. Fixed snapshot, no automatic refresh.

source.name: Eurostat EU-LFS
source.description: EU27 seasonally adjusted employment rate, ages 20–64, Q1 and Q2 2026. Different ages and periods from UK: no direct ranking.

evidenceFlow.title: Published evidence
evidenceFlow.detail: Read https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/products-eurostat-news/w/ddn-20260911-1 (release 2026-09-11); transcribe the rounded published values. Fixed snapshot, no automatic refresh.

adoption.title: UK adoption among businesses with 10+ employees

source.name: ONS BICS Wave 165
source.description: Percent of businesses with 10+ employees using AI. 2023 value derived as 38 minus published 26 percentage-point increase; rounded. Private-sector survey coverage; excludes some industries and public sector. Official statistics in development.

evidenceFlow.title: Published evidence
evidenceFlow.detail: Read https://www.ons.gov.uk/businessindustryandtrade/business/businessservices/bulletins/businessinsightsandimpactontheukeconomy/8october2026 (release 2026-10-08); transcribe the rounded published values. Fixed snapshot, no automatic refresh.

source.name: ONS BICS Wave 165
source.description: September 2026; among AI-adopting businesses with 10+ employees, 6% reported reduced headcount as a result of AI. Fewer than 1% reported increased headcount. Business-count-weighted self-report, not percentage of workers or a causal estimate. Do not infer the remaining response categories.
